moments.title: UK Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: The latest Official UK Singles Chart (August 7-13) sees Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold the top spot for a remarkable 20th week, while Ariana Grande makes new entries.

angles.name: #1 Reign
angles.copy: 20 weeks at number one for Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In'! Is it one of the biggest chart runs ever?

angles.name: Ariana's Chart Impact
angles.copy: Ariana Grande is making waves on the Official Singles Chart with two new entries this week! What's your favourite new track?

angles.name: Chart Talk
angles.copy: The UK's biggest songs are out! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean still reigning supreme, plus big moves from Ariana Grande. What are you listening to this weekend?
